description: This file appears to be a shell script used for platform-specific firmware upgrade operations in an embedded Linux environment, particularly for various TP-Link and other network devices. It defines functions to modify flash layout parameters, check image validity, and perform upgrades depending on device type.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Adjusts MTD partition layout and baud rate settings for specific TP-Link devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image, currently implemented as a no-op.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that selects upgrade procedure based on device type.
